set.body: PRD TR-1, TR-2, TR-4. Tracked(p, pupil) | Blink | Lost | OffScreen(p) — missing data is never a sentinel or null. Sample is UNIT-PARAMETERISED: this is what makes the detector unit guarantee real rather than theatre (DOC-3). Rate is Fixed(hz) | Irregular so variable-rate devices are representable.
